about.title: Leadership Rooted in Professionalism
about.p1: The Tanzania Sports Management Association (TSMA) is the national body overseeing the development of sports management, education, and policy in Tanzania.
about.p2: TSMA connects policymakers, investors, sports federations, academics and entrepreneurs to build a self-financing sports economy that creates jobs and drives development.
